title: Unit Event — THE POWER OF UNITY — Episode8 Taking the First Step

meta.Event Outline: As Akito repeatedly watches the video of RAD WEEKEND, he realizes that creating a certain "atmosphere" may be the key to surpassing the legend. Then, he hears that Len and the others are going to put on an event in SEKAI.

rows.Line: Live House
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Well...
The big day's already upon us.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Do you all feel ready?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
Right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
I'm ready to sing my heart out whenever!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same. Plus, we've put together a good crew. I'm sure things will turn out well for us.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
I agree.
However...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: No matter how much we practiced, it never felt like we ever came close to RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: The event itself is probably gonna be good, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't give up before it's even started...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I believe that all of us here are serious about what we're doing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No matter the cost, we all want to surpass RAD WEEKEND. Am I wrong in saying that we all feel that way?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If I'm right, we have to turn this event into a stepping stone towards achieving that goal.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: By struggling together, I'm sure we'll... No, I know we'll figure out something!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That atmosphere... The way it made everyone go totally nuts. We're gonna find a way to grab hold of it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Shinonome's right...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We don't have time to worry about what we can or can't do right now. For the sake of our dream, let's go out there and put on the best event possible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. We're gonna surpass that night!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice speech, you guys!!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Griping won't get us anywhere...
So let's just go all out during the show.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah!!
And all the way until the end!!

rows.Speaker: Akito & Arata
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Our first event... “Break”.
Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(EVER's leading us off...!
We're gonna come out of the gates swinging...!)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Try to keep up, you guys...!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Whoa!
They're so cool!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They're supposed to be the team that won against Kohane and the others before... No wonder too... This event's just getting started, but they've already turned everything upside down.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, I like him!
He's got some force behind him♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's like he knows exactly what his best qualities are! I'm having fun just listening to him, and the audience seems to be enjoying his performance.>

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone!
But we're still just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Looks like we've gotten them good and excited. I'd say about as excited when the headliner for a normal event's about to take the stage...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But we're still nowhere near achieving “that atmosphere”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But I think we're getting closer... Well, that's just my feeling...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I think so too.
This audience looks beyond excited.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That means this is our make-or-break moment. Wish me luck...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, Tono...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Keep it going!
We'll also keep it going once you're done!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, leave it to me.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
(Incredible...
I've never been in such an exhilarating event.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (I have a feeling the audience's excitement level is this high because EVER and Mita carried the torch so far for us...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (I still don't understand what it means to “take a look at this city,” but...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (I want to get them more excited...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (For Soma's sake... With everyone here...!)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
The last time I was this tired was after I'd battled against Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Alright, Vivid BAD SQUAD!
Give us a good finale!
song00005_off_f

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, we will...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Alright, here comes our last act...!
Give it up for Vivid BAD SQUAD!!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Bring it on home, you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What is this? It feels way different from any other event...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
It feels so good... Like the stage and crowd are both totally on fire...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is this what people mean by “rocking the floor”...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, this has to be it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But this isn't the peak.
The atmosphere from RAD WEEKEND is still lying up ahead somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
All of you!
Sing like you're gonna surpass it today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Man... I'm completely out of gas...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Same...
Normally, we'd start cleaning up immediately, but let's take a quick break before we do.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm not gonna lie, I don't think I've ever used up so much energy before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
I always sang with everything I had until now, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Today felt different... It felt new...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what did you guys think...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How was today's “atmosphere”?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Hehe.
You really need to ask?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess I don't need to based on the look on your faces...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're still far from RAD WEEKEND...
But we took a big step forward.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did!
Also, it was super fun!
It totally felt like I was gonna fly away while I sang!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I know, right...?!
Oh, I had this idea too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Can we try doing more events together as a group like this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Um... Well...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We've sung alongside a bunch of other teams until now, but I've never felt this kind of excitement from start to finish during an event before...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It probably has to do with us taking our music seriously... And how we're all trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a feeling that if we get to know each other better and practice like we really mean it, we'll be able to put on an even more amazing event...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm all for that!
Especially since we're so close to getting a hold of some kind of answer. It'd be a waste to just call it quits now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
If the rest of you are okay with it, I'd like us to go forward with this idea.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
I mean, the show we just put on was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
It really was...
We probably wouldn't have been able to do so well at any other event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm with you there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'd rather not take the scenic route when it comes to achieving my dream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, what's that supposed to...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So, Akito, I'll be looking forward to singing more with you...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Because I believe we'll find the quickest way there as long as we're together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... Do you have to do that every single time?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, everyone, let's decide what we'll be doing for our next event!

rows.Speaker: An & Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah!
The next day
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Nice work, you guys!
That was such an amazing show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was!
The crowd went bonkers too!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, Len, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, we didn't get anywhere close to what happened during RAD WEEKEND, but I'm glad everybody had fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, same! We even decided to start doing more events as a group!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Really? That's a wonderful idea!
That means you'll be making even more delicious pancakes for us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, I believe it's our turn now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Our event!
We got all set up while you were making your own preparations.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't we call it a celebration for an event well done? I'll be singing with everything I have for the first time in a while too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, come to the terrace so we can get hyped up together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're welcome to jump in too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If that's the case, we might just have to accept...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!!
Here we go! Round 2!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, let's do this!
Start the music!!
